title: Live-review apply: a failed market read in the noise-floor probe returns refuse/bad_input instead of could_not_look; IB reads use clientId 498, which is already in use on the VM
note: Found by the manager (01MdQiC8) in VM dry-run #20165, 2026-10-25 20:37Z, VM at 81a0b836. 12 verdicts across 8 open packages. Bybit (6 legs: xrp and ada on bybit_1, bybit_2, bybit_portfolio): approve within_bounds, correct. Alpaca (4): no_amend_path (3) and would_loosen (1), correct. ib_paper (mgc_pullback_1d, mhg_pullback_1d): refuse bad_input, WRONG. The IB OHLCV read failed with Error 326, clientId 498 already in use, and then the circuit breaker tripped. The probe's new_sl was None, so approve_amend's 'new_sl is None -> refuse(R_BAD_INPUT)' check in src/runtime/live_review_intent.py fired before the mark/atr could_not_look check. Fix: (1) when new_sl is None because mark or atr is missing, return could_not_look:<missing>; keep bad_input for a genuinely malformed intent. Add a test. (2) Give the live-review apply path's IB market-data reads a dedicated clientId that does not collide, or read IB candles through the trader's existing feed; check which process holds 498. Gate: the operator's popup ~19:57Z ties the MD-LIVE-TIGHTEN-SL grant and the apply flip to a dry-run correct for every account. Closing observation: a re-run of live-review-dry-run shows could_not_look, not bad_input, for any unreadable account, or a successful IB read.
